blocking_findings: [high][R2-T4-H1] The accepted R1 snapshot is incomplete and must be recaptured. FR2.2 requires workspace/lock configuration, but measure/business_operations_graph_baseline_snapshot.py:43 limits manifest names to package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, and pnpm-lock.yaml. The accepted manifest's baseline commit 0dad54c3 contains tracked .pnpmfile.cjs at SHA-256 a54e0734696f8f1c4127ce5d2ab3a2f24d74e2a5cd8ad19ef85624d8437764a9, while neither discovery.configPaths nor the 6,783 manifest/archive entries contains it. The archived and baseline lockfiles both bind pnpmfileChecksum sha256-pU4HNGlvjxxBJ85dKrOi8k104qXNitGe+FYk2EN3ZKk=. Consequently every one of the six exact accepted-snapshot FR5 commands exits 1 at PNPM_LOCKFILE_CONFIG_MISMATCH before its package script runs, exactly as retained at ledger.json:107496-107640. The Task 4 ledger correctly labels this BLOCKED, but the defect invalidates R1's claim to a complete executable source snapshot and cannot be repaired by treating the shared-worktree diagnostics as substitutes. Exact remediation: add the root .pnpmfile.cjs to snapshot discovery, drift/status/staged-diff binding, archive replay, and focused counterexamples; perform a new coordinated R1 stable-window snapshot and canonical scan; then regenerate/rebind affected R2 evidence and rerun the exact FR5 commands against that newly accepted snapshot.

Add exact enums, owning-package/config derivation, exclusion-cause verification, exact anchor-span rules, and a hash-bound command registry with per-file type/test applicability; execute each new semantic adversary through validate_ledger.
